name: al-buddy-memory
description: Your work with Claude, never lost: long-term memory on your own computer, shared with Claude Code, that you keep forever and can take anywhere.
long_description: Claude remembers decisions, preferences and facts across conversations. Everything is kept in one file on your computer (`~/.al-buddy-memory/brain.db`, the same one the Claude Code plugin uses, so both apps share one memory). Every fact keeps where it came from and since when it has been true; a fact that stops being true is retired with a date, never overwritten. Nothing is sent anywhere: no account, no telemetry. The search model (about 90 MB) is downloaded once from Hugging Face on first start, then runs offline.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a durable fact, with who said it and since when

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search memory; every result carries its source and validity

tools.name: invalidate
tools.description: Retire a fact that stopped being true; it is kept in history

tools.name: pin
tools.description: Pin a standing rule for every conversation

tools.name: mental_model

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export memory in the documented portable format

db_path.description: Where your memory is kept. Leave it as it is to share one memory with Claude Code.
